body: Opus2 lesson (2026-11-13): to verify a ref in another project's repository (e.g. Engram author-test refs), use `git ls-remote` only. A `git fetch` in C:\github\Personal\Engram writes objects and FETCH_HEAD into another project's .git, outside the TermAl repository rule. Bundles made read-only with `git -C <worktree> bundle create <TermAl .tmp path>` are fine (they write only into TermAl's .tmp). Commit/tree/parent checks can use objects already present (git show on a known local commit) or the runner's own fetch.
